verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's own `ai_query` and `ai_extract_rules` parameters let a user say in plain language what data to pull from a page, so natural-language input is a documented capability. It is limited to extraction. Operating the product itself (rendering, proxies, JS scenarios, crawling, scheduling) still uses structured parameters and JSON instructions. missing for 10: natural-language control of scraping/configuration actions beyond extraction, documentation of NL command depth or accuracy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: ai_query [string] ("") The information you want to extract from the webpage using AI
Use `extract_rules` for CSS/XPath-based extraction and `ai_query` or `ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction.
Choose AI extraction when the desired field is semantic or the structure is irregular.
